newsitem.title: USA: Police seek man who attacked beauticians.
newsitem.headline: Police seek man who attacked beauticians.

text.p: Orlando police said Tuesday they were hunting for a man who terrorised a beauticians' convention, bludgeoned a participant to death, and kidnapped and raped another.
Police said a man wielding a three-foot-long car jack approached two conventioneers, a man and a woman, outside an Orlando hotel early Monday and forced them into a secluded area.
The assailant killed the man by hitting him with the jack, and rolled his body into a pond.

He then held the woman hostage for three hours, raping her twice and striking her with the jack as well before she escaped by convincing him she would give him her valuables if she took him to her room.
He ran away when he saw her roommates, police said.

The assault panicked conference participants. But Sgt. Bill Mulloy of the Orlando Police Department said the killer did not appear to be stalking beauticians. He described the attack as a random act of cruelty.
